Railway RRC NFR Apprentice Online Form 2024 (5,647 Posts) – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR), Guwahati has released the notification for the post of Apprentices. This recruitment has been issued for 5,647 posts. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official All India Exam Result 2025 website which is All India Exam Result

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 04 November 2024
  • Application Start Date : 04 November 2024
  • Last Date : 03 December 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 December 2024
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : 0/-
  • All Category Female Candidates : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
